topic: How does the LPF's 25 GHz stopband impact interference mitigation in multi-beam satellite downlink frequency planning?
response: The 25 GHz stopband of the LPF affects interference mitigation by limiting out-of-band emissions, thus reducing adjacent channel interference in multi-beam satellite downlink frequency planning, adhering to standards like ITU-R S.524-9.
reference_context: Satellite communications utilize beamforming and precoding for interference mitigation, focusing on frequency bands like 17.3-20.2 GHz and 27.5-30 GHz.
